wa_batskins.notes: Arch feature with natural gear to ledge anchor; full pitch continues past bolts through shallow groove, tricky stemming, cruxy knobs section, moves left to anchor.
Thin ramp then stemming corner with knobs to a testy balance crux high up; 3 bolts plus small gear for crux.

wa_bowling_to_biscuits.notes: Short crack on a pedestal ~30ft left of Peanuts, layback up/right to face holds (2 bolts), ends at 2-bolt chained anchor below the roof.
Pumpy jams pulling the roof into sustained corner jamming; widens near the top; best crack at Lookout Point.
